title: Automotive Tune-Up and Electronics Specialist
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: AUTOMOTIVE TUNE-UP and ELECTRONICS SPECIALIST CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
outcomes: Locate service information from available sources, determine specifications, locate procedures, determine parts and labor charges and accurately complete a repair order.
Describe the theory and operation of automotive systems and circuits. Explain technical procedures and legal processes.
Demonstrate competency in service and repair by being able to test, adjust, diagnose, repair, calibrate, and validate repairs on a variety of automotive systems.
Demonstrate knowledge of safe working habits in an automotive repair facility.

blocks.name: Plus 3 additional units selected from the following

notes: The catalog prints AUT 166 as 'Automotive Diagnosis and Tune-Up' and AUT 170 as 'Advanced Engine and Emission Controls'; the closed list titles differ ('Automotive Engine Performance', 'Advanced Automotive Engine Performance'). Units match.
The outcomes printed under this certificate are identical to the program-level outcomes printed just above the section heading (end of the preceding automotive program on page 105).

'licensed smog Inspector' is taken from the sentence about California Bureau of Automotive Repair certification; the description also mentions 'entry-level positions' and 'career progression within the automotive industry', not recorded as specific careers.
Following sections (Advanced Automotive Hybrid and Electric Vehicle; Automotive Chassis Specialist) belong to other awards and were not read.
